scripts.build:test-bundles: for f in db levels commands/leveling commands/titles menu-source commands/menu traffic-source commands/traffic scheduled github-relay index; do out=$(basename $f); esbuild src/$f.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=test/.bundled-$out.mjs --external:node:sqlite; done
scripts.test: npm run build:test-bundles && for f in test/*.test.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
